name: bastra-recall
description: Proactive local memory skill for Bastra Recall in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Shared memory guidance for ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Keep preferences, decisions and lessons available across sessions with Bastra Recall. This plugin supplies the memory Skill; install the required local service and hooks with `bastra install codex`. Retrieved memories are passed to your AI client as context.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $bastra-recall to retrieve relevant durable context before acting.
